mn45:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn45:2.3: atthi bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkha vipākaṃ.
mn45:2.4: atthi bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañceva āyatiñca dukkhavipākaṃ.
mn45:2.5: atthi bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhaṃ āyatiṃ sukhavipākaṃ.
mn45:2.6: atthi bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañceva āyatiñca sukhavipākaṃ.
mn45:3.1: katamañca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkhavipākaṃ?
mn45:3.2: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn45:3.7: ‘kiṃsu nāma te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāmesu anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā kāmānaṃ pahānamāhaṃsu, kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpenti?
mn45:3.8: sukho imissā paribbājikāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso’ti. te kāmesu pātavyataṃ āpajjanti.
mn45:3.9: te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
mn45:3.10: te tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn45:3.12: ‘idaṃ kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāmesu anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā kāmānaṃ pahānamāhaṃsu, kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpenti, imehi mayaṃ kāmahetu kāmanidānā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāmā’ti.
mn45:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gimhānaṃ pacchime māse māluvāsipāṭikā phaleyya,
mn45:4.2: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave māluvābījaṃ aññatarasmiṃ sālamūle nipateyya,
mn45:4.3: atha kho bhikkhave yā tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthā devatā sā bhītā saṃviggā santāsaṃ āpajjeyya.
mn45:4.4: atha kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanaspatīsu adhivatthā devatā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ:
mn45:4.6: appeva nāmetaṃ māluvā bījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā udrabheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā panassā’ti.
mn45:4.7: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave māluvābījaṃ neva moro gileyya, na mago khādeyya, na davaḍāho ḍaheyya, na vanakammikā uddhareyyuṃ, na upacikā udrabheyyuṃ, bījaṃva panassa. taṃ pāvussakena meghena abhippavaṭṭhaṃ sammadeva virūḷheyya.
mn45:4.8: sāssa māluvālatā taruṇā mudukā lomasā vilambinī, sā taṃ sālaṃ upaniseveyya.
mn45:4.9: atha kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya evamassa:
mn45:4.10: “kiṃsu nāma te bhonto mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanaspatīsu adhivatthā devatā māluvābīje anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāsesuṃ:
mn45:4.11: mā bhavaṃ bhāyi. mā bhavaṃ bhāyi.
mn45:4.12: appeva nāmetaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā udrabheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā panassāti.
mn45:4.13: sukho imissā māluvālatāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya vilambiniyā samphasso”ti.
mn45:4.15: sā taṃ sālaṃ anupariharitvā upari viṭabhiṃ kareyya,
mn45:4.17: oghanaṃ janetvā ye tassa sālassa mahantā mahantā khandhā te padāleyya.
mn45:4.18: atha kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya evamassa:
mn45:4.19: “idaṃ kho te bhonto mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanappatīsu adhivatthā devatā māluvābīje anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāsesuṃ:
mn45:4.20: mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi. appeva nāmetaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā udrabheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā panassāti,
mn45:4.21: yañcāhaṃ māluvābījahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāmī”ti.
mn45:4.22: evameva kho bhikkhave santi eke samaṇa brāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino: natthi kāmesu dosoti.
mn45:4.26: kiṃ su nāma te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāmesu anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā kāmānaṃ pahānamāhaṃsu, kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpenti?
mn45:4.27: ‘sukho imissā paribbājikāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso’ti.
mn45:4.29: te kāmesu pātavyataṃ āpajjitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
mn45:4.30: te tattha dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn45:4.32: idaṃ kho bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kāmesu anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānā kāmānaṃ pahānamāhaṃsu. kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpenti.
mn45:4.33: ime hi mayaṃ kāmahetu kāmanidānā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāmā’ti.
mn45:4.34: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkhavipākaṃ.
mn45:5.1: katamañca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañceva āyatiñca dukkhavipākaṃ?
mn45:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco acelako hoti muttācāro hatthāvalekhano. na ehibhaddantiko na tiṭṭhabhadantiko, na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakaṭaṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.
mn45:5.3: so na kumbhimukhā patigaṇhāti, na kaḷopimukhā patigaṇhāti, na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittīsu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ. na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pibati.
mn45:5.4: so ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko, dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko …pe… sattāgāriko vā hoti sattālopiko.
mn45:5.5: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpeti, dvīhipi dattīhi yāpeti …pe… sattahipi dattīhi yāpeti.
mn45:5.6: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dvāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti, …pe… sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāreti. iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
mn45:5.7: so sākabhakkho vā hoti sāmākabhakkho vā hoti nīvārabhakkho vā hoti daddulabhakkho vā hoti haṭabhakkho vā hoti kaṇabhakkho vā hoti ācāmabhakkho vā hoti piññākabhakkho vā hoti tiṇabhakkho vā hoti gomayabhakkho vā hoti. vanamūlaphalāhāro vā yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.
mn45:5.8: so sāṇānipi dhāreti masāṇānipi dhāreti chavadussānipi dhāreti paṃsukūlānipi dhāreti tirīṭānipi dhāreti ajinānipi dhāreti ajinakkhipampi dhāreti kusacīrampi dhāreti vākacīrampi dhāreti phalakacīrampi dhāreti kesakambalampi dhāreti vāḷakambalampi dhāreti ulūkapakkhampi dhāreti.
mn45:5.14: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
mn45:5.15: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
mn45:5.16: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañceva āyatiñca dukkhavipākaṃ.
mn45:6.1: katamañca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhaṃ āyatiṃ sukhavipākaṃ?
mn45:6.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco pakatiyā tibbarāgajātiko hoti. so abhikkhaṇaṃ rāgajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:6.3: pakatiyā tibbadosajātiko hoti, so abhikkhaṇaṃ dosajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:6.4: pakatiyā tibbamohajātiko hoti, so abhikkhaṇaṃ mohajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:6.5: so sahāpi dukkhena sahāpi domanassena assumukho rudamāno paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati.
mn45:6.6: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn45:6.7: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhaṃ āyatiṃ sukhavipākaṃ.
mn45:7.1: katamañca bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañceva āyatiñca sukhavipākaṃ?
mn45:7.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco pakatiyā na tibbarāgajātiko hoti, so na abhikkhaṇaṃ rāgajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:7.3: pakatiyā na tibbadosajātiko hoti, so na abhikkhaṇaṃ dosajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:7.4: pakatiyā na tibbamohajātiko hoti, so na abhikkhaṇaṃ mohajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn45:7.5: so vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn45:7.6: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti
mn45:7.7: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassa domanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhā satipārisuddhiṃ
mn45:7.9: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
mn45:7.10: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañceva āyatiñca sukhavipākaṃ.
mn45:7.13: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
